subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Technology Export Controls
description: A 60-second lesson on Technology Export Controls.

hook.text: The US bans NVIDIA from selling advanced AI chips to China. The chip war is the new trade war.

buildup.text: Technology export controls restrict the sale of advanced tech — chips, software, AI — to rival nations.

discovery.text: The US CHIPS Act and export controls aim to maintain America's semiconductor advantage over China.

twist.text: China is investing $150 billion to build its own chip industry. Export controls may delay but not prevent catch-up.

climax.text: Technology is the new battlefield of geopolitics. Controlling who gets advanced tech is controlling power itself.

punchline.text: No chips for rivals. Technology is the new weapon of power.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of US technology export controls on China?
options: To maintain semiconductor and AI advantage over a strategic rival
To increase chip sales to China
To reduce US technology research spending
